October Climate Showdown: Rome vs. Lisbon

This comparison provides a snapshot of the typical weather conditions in Rome and Lisbon during October to help with your travel planning. It outlines key climate metrics to help you decide which city best suits your preference for warmer, sunnier weather.

A Note on Climate Averages

The following data is based on long-term historical climate averages and should be used as a general guide, not a live weather forecast. Actual weather conditions in October 2024 can vary. It is always recommended to check a detailed forecast closer to your travel dates.

October Weather Comparison Table

| City | Average High (°C) | Average Low (°C) | Average Rainy Days | Average Sunshine (Hours/Day) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rome, Italy | 22°C | 12°C | 8 | 6 |
| Lisbon, Portugal | 22°C | 15°C | 9 | 7 |

Recommendation for Sun-Seekers

For a tourist who prefers warmer and sunnier conditions, Lisbon is the recommended choice for an October trip.

While both cities boast a pleasant average high temperature of 22°C, Lisbon's key advantages are its warmer evenings and greater amount of sunshine. The average low in Lisbon is a comfortable 15°C compared to Rome's cooler 12°C, making it more pleasant for evening activities. Additionally, Lisbon typically offers an extra hour of sunshine per day. Although it has a slightly higher number of rainy days on average, the combination of warmer nights and more sun makes it the better option for your stated preferences.
